e.title: eva (R)
e.summary: 极值分析+拟合优度检验 R 包（CRAN）：GEV/GPD 估计与假设检验
e.body: eva（R CRAN）是极值分析（EVA）R 包，特色是拟合优度检验（goodness-of-fit testing）：GEV 与 GPD 分布的参数估计（MLE）、假设检验、重现水平与尾部概率计算。对 RIAA：极值建模的假设检验工具——在 [[ismev]]/[[extremes]] 等拟合基础上做模型诊断与比较（[[extreme-value-theory]]）；与 [[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[pyextremes]] 同族；保险场景见 [[insurance-evt]]、[[extremeloss]]。
e.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：极值分析+拟合优度检验包
e.summary_en: Extreme Value Analysis with goodness-of-fit testing (R CRAN): GEV/GPD estimation and hypothesis testing
e.summary_hk: 極值分析+擬合優度檢驗 R 包（CRAN）：GEV/GPD 估計與假設檢驗
e.body_en: eva (R CRAN) is an Extreme Value Analysis (EVA) R package whose distinctive feature is goodness-of-fit testing: parameter estimation (MLE) of GEV and GPD distributions, hypothesis tests, return levels and tail probabilities. For RIAA: a hypothesis-testing tool for extreme-value modelling — model diagnostics and comparison on top of fitting from [[ismev]]/[[extremes]] ([[extreme-value-theory]]); same family as [[evir]], [[mev]] and [[pyextremes]]; insurance applications: [[insurance-evt]], [[extremeloss]].
e.body_hk: eva（R CRAN）是極值分析（EVA）R 套件，特色是擬合優度檢驗（goodness-of-fit testing）：GEV 與 GPD 分佈的參數估計（MLE）、假設檢驗、重現水平與尾部概率計算。對 RIAA：極值建模的假設檢驗工具——在 [[ismev]]/[[extremes]] 等擬合基礎上做模型診斷與比較（[[extreme-value-theory]]）；與 [[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[pyextremes]] 同族；保險場景見 [[insurance-evt]]、[[extremeloss]]。
